static_same_image_counts.interpretation: Current-evaluation saturation is concentrated on shifted/misaligned visits (555 of703 saturated recovery decisions), absent on this selected same-image support. This is not proof actor has no off-support saturation defect.

learning_primary_recount.interpretation: No numerical-loss explosion observed in examined metrics. Lower alpha and changed Q scale are correlates, not isolated causes. Recovery sampling heavily repeats 665 rows and is dominated by actor followup/control rows; raw SAC has no direct executed-target mean supervision.

ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.hypothesis: Global policy retention loss changes initial steering/pedal coupling, moves rollouts off successful-state support, then heading reversal and saturated corrective actions/stalls become frequent.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.support: Identical initial pixels but all12 steering decreases,5 sign flips, all12 initial brakes lower; failure-followup static steering error grows; all5 original finishes lost; recovery misaligned visits2486/4924 vs994/4670; static-support saturation remains5/665.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.counterevidence: Control also changes initial steering and loses3 original finishes but gains2. Road3 candidate succeeds. Heading/lateral thresholds occur in all5 original finishes, so thresholds are not causes themselves.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.guidance_relevance: Prior reference retention is justified as a distinct hypothesis; ensure protection is not only on Oracle/recovery states. Selected historical prior may not cover initial/current off-support pixels.

ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.hypothesis: Joint speed/steering recovery was not learned: steering alignment improved while gas remains excessive and braking on failure-Oracle support is below executed target; local understeer/low-brake changes accelerate some curve approaches.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.support: Fixed overspeed12/12 and147 decisions; same-image failure Oracle gas error+.868883,brake-.018913; first40 roads4/6/7/10/12 much faster than source; road12 lane loss with steer-.991/gas.966/brake.007.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.counterevidence: Whole-trace speed25.117<source27.606; recovery brake median.1333>source.1066; original11/12 overspeed episodes and5 finishes; candidate road3 finishes despite thresholds. Roads1/8 lost at similar/lower early speed.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.guidance_relevance: Joint deterministic mean steering/gas/brake guidance, not steer-only or unconditional speed cap. It remains untested and teacher labels are sequence-dependent/privileged.

ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.hypothesis: Raw-SAC recovery replay is insufficient to change actor means toward successful actions; teacher transitions stay disfavored by current Q and most selected recovery draws are high-gas actor followup rather than Oracle intervention.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.support: All3 critics favor own actor on87/87 failure-Oracle states; recovery mean target-minus-actor Q gap remains negative; only17289/131056 recovery draws failure-Oracle; repeated665 rows161..250 draws each.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.counterevidence: Q gap narrows and steeringMAE improves; absolute Q scales differ; sequence success does not prove each teacher action optimal under current-policy continuation. No target-ranking causal attribution established.
ranked_causal_hypotheses_not_proven.guidance_relevance: Direct mean guidance can bypass current-Q preference but needs retention controls and full-finish evaluation; adding more repeats of this same raw-SAC pool alone has no demonstrated advantage.

recommendation: No alternative intervention is clearly better established than guided joint mean plus prior retention. Do not substitute global braking/steering clamp or retune narrow terminal endpoint. Keep full finish and lost-old-success counts as decisive outcomes.
limitations: Matched road/reset observations, not transition-matched causal learner comparison after initial fork; single learner seed and reused TRAIN roads only.
Whole-trace medians weight long episodes and stationary/reversed tails; early40 and heading-conditioned views are provided to avoid equating pooled lower speed with safer curve entry.
center_error is a nearest-current-road telemetry proxy; small terminal lateral error can coexist with heading reversal, stall and off_track_counter101.
Damage and progress are post-step trace fields; speed/lateral/heading are pre-decision. Terminal-only fields and final post_speed are included, not silently treated as pre-state.
No archived replay reconstruction, environment construction, model inference/update, confirmation/blind/private/official action, existing-code/docs edits or commits.
